purpose: Structured CFPB named-redress ledger distinguishing ongoing distribution, reported check delivery, and closed aggregate compensation while preserving recipient receipt, obligation correction, recovery, trust, and exit as open stages; FY2024 cashing rates and FY2025 redistribution follow-ups are retained as separate stages.

boundary: This ledger formalizes six official named CFPB redress routes at aggregate, administrator, or completed-distribution status. It adds aggregate funds-cashed rates but does not claim individual receipt, adequate compensation, account correction, recovery, trust change, switching, or exit.
storage_boundary: Only compact page-derived route fields, source URLs, and explicit uncertainty are retained; no administrator file, recipient-level data, or raw payment file is downloaded.
